title: Wicked West: Historical Walking Adventure in Downtown Denver
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the captivating history of LoDo on this engaging 2.5-hour walking tour. Starting at the iconic House of Mirrors, uncover the intriguing characters and events that have shaped this vibrant area. As you stroll through the streets, enjoy scenic views of downtown Denver while immersing yourself in its colorful past. The tour concludes in the beautiful and historic Larimer Square, offering a perfect backdrop to reflect on the stories shared along the way.

- 2.5-hour guided walking tour through LoDo's history
- Begins at 20th and Market Street, outside the House of Mirrors
- Concludes in the picturesque Larimer Square
- Discover the fascinating tales of Denver's past
